object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Export tables with two leading header rows (the first a merged cell over both columns) over a body row; with a header row, a body row, a later header row and more body rows; with a header row only below the body; with a header cell spanning into the body, alone and followed by a later header row; with no header row. Expected: the first two tables repeat their leading header rows at the top of each page they continue onto, and the second keeps its later header row as a row of the body; the others repeat no row.
